# Energy Transfer LP Update

Report 098 | Published 2022-11-27 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-11-27/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/098.json)

Energy income amid macro caution.

Concrete wins include ET distribution restoration, the December TGA ceiling and three-year Bitcoin direction. Oil bullishness for 2024-25 and the 2023 recession call failed. Europe avoided unusually deep winter storage depletion, and growth stocks dominated the disclosed interim style comparisons. Conditional branches, quoted prior forecasts and undated valuation opinions must remain separate from resolved predictions.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

Most money is commercial-bank deposits created through lending; banks do not simply multiply central-bank reserves or lend preexisting saver deposits.

## Framework lessons

- Separate cash-flow value from macro timing.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
